newsitem.title: MEXICO: ICA highway concession in 3 bln peso debt.
newsitem.headline: ICA highway concession in 3 bln peso debt.

text.p: A subsidiary of Mexican construction firm Empresas ICA which holds the concession to run the Guadalajara-Tepic highway, contracted three billion pesos in debt during the first quarter of 1997, ICA said on Monday.
The debt had "the aim of achieving a debt-to-equity ratio of three-to-one originally foreseen in the concession award," an ICA statement said.
ICA said in a conference call among analysts at the beginning of March that it had contracted 1.75 billion pesos of debt during the first quarter for the highway concession.
"The company hopes this new loan will form part of the (financial) restructuring of highways currently under negotiation with the federal government," the statement added.
